text:
maria-g: Hey team — can someone pin a combined dashboard (EU + US model health + cost) to the oncall workspace before Friday? Finance will be watching the cost tile for the end-of-week report.

devon: which dashboards do you want combined? we usually keep model-health-eu, model-health-us, and infra-costs as separate tiles. I can make a playlist or a single dashboard with row panels.

maria-g: Ideally a single dashboard that has: 1) model p95/p99 by region, 2) active model versions + error rate, 3) token-cost trend last 24h. playlist is fine if pinning is easier.

anuj: I tried the grafana shortlink from the runbook and got a 403. "Access denied: you don't have permission to view this dashboard." Anyone else seeing that?

maria-g: same — clicking the shortlink returns 403 for me too. I can open other dashboards but not the model health ones.

devon: weird. what's the shortlink you're using? paste it here and I'll test from my account.

maria-g: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/abc123/model-health?orgId=1 (clicked from oncall workspace)

devon: I can access that one. @maria-g can you try incognito or `curl -I` to check headers?

maria-g: ran `curl -I 'https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/abc123/model-health'` and got `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` plus `x-grafana-err: permission denied` in the response.

sre-bot: [alert] model-latency-eu p95 > 500ms (last 10m). Rule: model-latency-p95-eu.

carmen: likely an org/role RBAC issue — some dashboards are limited to group `observability-read` and the oncall workspace service account isn't in that group.

devon: @carmen can you confirm which group is required? we recently tightened access for a subset of dashboards with cost tiles.

carmen: yep — cost and model-version tiles were scoped to `observability-read` and `finance-view` during last month's audit. oncall service account only had `oncall-basic`. I can add `observability-read` but need approval from infra-iam for `finance-view`.

maria-g: ok please add `observability-read` — that should unblock oncall. for finance-view we only need read-only cost tiles; can coordinate with finance next week.

devon: I created a merge request to generate a new composite dashboard and pinned panels. Also created a shortlink: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/xyz987/multi-region-model-cost. can you test that one?

maria-g: clicking that new one still gives 403. same error.

anuj: FYI, the service-account tokens used by the workspace expire every 6h; if it was added to a group recently you might need to trigger a token refresh. try `/reconnect-grafana` from the workspace or re-login.

carmen: I requested the group change with infra-iam and gave them the MR number and shortlink. MR: https://git.internal/repo/infra-iam/merge/4321 — they asked for a justification, I put: "enable oncall and finance read for model-health and cost tiles for weekend monitoring".

devon: alternative quick fix: share the dashboard snapshot (View -> Share -> Snapshot) which doesn't require RBAC. I'll generate one and drop it here for Friday as a temporary measure.

maria-g: snapshot would work for the immediate need (non-interactive). but we do want pinned live view for alert drilldowns.

sre-bot: [info] scheduled job: oncall-rotation-checklist will post the weekend dashboard shortlink at 08:00 UTC Fri if access is confirmed.

carmen: infra-iam approved `observability-read` for the oncall workspace service account. please re-test now, @maria-g @anuj.

maria-g: re-tested, still 403 — but I think it's because token cache didn't refresh. I ran `/reconnect-grafana` and now I can open the new shortlink ✅

devon: great. I'll pin https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/xyz987/multi-region-model-cost to the oncall workspace and add a note in the handover doc.

maria-g: thanks all. follow-ups: (1) devon to pin and add runbook link, (2) carmen will follow up with infra-iam on `finance-view` access for finance users, (3) devon will post a snapshot as fallback for Friday.

anuj: closing loop — I'll add a small alert tweak request to reduce noisy p95 flaps: increase threshold by 10% for models with stable traffic, and add a 2m cooldown. filing a ticket: https://go/reqs/9876.

maria-g: perfect. :thumbsup:

carmen: I'll also add the dashboard to the team watchlist and create a pinned shortlink in Confluence.
